archetypes.name: dyn-attribution
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer attribution now depends on collector provenance across review surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress report attribution remap changes. Check that collector-results.env lookup order is correct for implement, review, and design plan-review layouts. Verify code-review base labels still match Top reviewers labels and design labels remain unchanged. Look for edge cases around missing manifest fields, unknown tools, and same-vendor execution. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
